primary_binary.seed_mean: calculate each seed binary indicator before per-ID arithmetic mean
primary_binary.supported: at least one improving CI excludes zero; neither harms; at least two seeds improve that metric
primary_binary.worsened: confusion CI lower > 0 or success CI upper < 0
primary_binary.missing: descriptive indicators false; any missing primary ALL/VIS pose => NOT_ESTIMABLE
primary_binary.A1_guard: primary frame-bootstrap WORSENED or NOT_ESTIMABLE => stop before A2

definitions.seed_mean_rates: arithmetic mean of3 binary indicators, no thresholding averaged errors
definitions.corner: existing canonical proper symmetry branch and full GT-valid corner denominator
